import unittest
from shipping import shipping_label
class TestShippingLabel(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(shipping_label(0), 'light')
        self.assertEqual(shipping_label(9), 'light')
        self.assertEqual(shipping_label(10), 'heavy')
        self.assertEqual(shipping_label(100), 'freight')
        self.assertEqual(shipping_label(101), 'freight')
if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
